name: demo-video
description: Plan, record, and package browser product demo videos from Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Create browser demo videos with Playwright and ffmpeg.
interface.longDescription: Demo Video gives Codex a local workflow for planning product demos, recording browser interactions with Playwright, generating narration scripts/subtitles, and exporting client-ready video files with ffmpeg.
interface.defaultPrompt: Create a browser demo video for this product.
